011import io.papermc.paper.datacomponent.DataComponentTypes;
012import io.papermc.paper.datacomponent.item.MapItemColor;
013import net.tnemc.item.component.SerialComponent;
014import net.tnemc.item.component.impl.MapColorComponent;
015import net.tnemc.item.paper.PaperItemStack;
016import net.tnemc.item.providers.VersionUtil;
017import org.bukkit.Color;
018import org.bukkit.inventory.ItemStack;
019
020import java.util.Optional;
021
022/**
023 * Replaces TNIL's map color component, which references {@code DataComponentTypes.MAP_COLOR}.
024 *
025 * <p>Paper 26.3 removed that data component, so the component disables itself when the field is
026 * missing instead of throwing {@link NoSuchFieldError} on every item serialization.</p>
027 */
028public class PaperMapColorComponent extends MapColorComponent<PaperItemStack, ItemStack> {
029
030  private static final boolean AVAILABLE = hasMapColor();
031
032  public PaperMapColorComponent() {
033
034    super();
035  }
036
037  public PaperMapColorComponent(final int mapColor) {
038
039    super(mapColor);
040  }
041
042  @Override
043  public boolean enabled(final String version) {
044
045    return AVAILABLE && VersionUtil.isOneTwentyOneFour(version);
046  }
047
048  @Override
049  public boolean appliesTo(final ItemStack item) {
050
051    return true;
052  }
053
054  @Override
055  public ItemStack apply(final PaperItemStack serialized, final ItemStack item) {
056
057    final Optional<PaperMapColorComponent> component = serialized.component(identifier());
058    if(component.isEmpty()) {
059      return item;
060    }
061
062    item.setData(DataComponentTypes.MAP_COLOR, MapItemColor.mapItemColor()
063            .color(Color.fromARGB(component.get().mapColor())));
064    return item;
065  }
066
067  @Override
068  public PaperItemStack serialize(final ItemStack item, final PaperItemStack serialized) {
069
070    final MapItemColor color = item.getData(DataComponentTypes.MAP_COLOR);
071    if(color == null) {
072      return serialized;
073    }
074
075    final SerialComponent<?, ?> existing = serialized.paperComponent(identifier());
076    final PaperMapColorComponent component = (existing instanceof final MapColorComponent<?, ?> mapColor)
077                                             ? (PaperMapColorComponent)mapColor
078                                             : new PaperMapColorComponent();
079    component.mapColor(color.color().asARGB());
080    serialized.applyComponent(component);
081    return serialized;
082  }
083
084  private static boolean hasMapColor() {
085
086    try {
087      DataComponentTypes.class.getField("MAP_COLOR");
088      return true;
089    } catch(final NoSuchFieldException ignored) {
090      return false;
091    }
092  }
093}
